mapper.sql: select o.order_id, o.order_no, o.member_id, o.product_id, o.product_type, o.product_title, o.product_cover, o.unit_price, o.quantity, o.amount, o.pay_amount, o.status, o.pay_type, o.pay_time, o.travel_date, o.contact_name, o.contact_phone, o.remark, o.ship_time, o.finish_time, o.refund_time, o.refund_reason, o.after_sale, o.create_time, o.update_time from hys_order o
mapper.select: select o.order_id, o.order_no, o.member_id, o.product_id, o.product_type, o.product_title, o.product_cover, o.unit_price, o.quantity, o.amount, o.pay_amount, o.status, o.pay_type, o.pay_time, o.travel_date, o.contact_name, o.contact_phone, o.remark, o.ship_time, o.finish_time, o.refund_time, o.refund_reason, o.after_sale, o.create_time, o.update_time, m.nickname as member_name, m.phone as member_phone from hys_order o left join hys_member m on m.member_id = o.member_id where o.order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: insert into hys_order (order_no, member_id, product_id, product_type, product_title, product_cover, unit_price, quantity, amount, pay_amount, status, travel_date, contact_name, contact_phone, remark, after_sale, create_time, update_time) values (#{orderNo}, #{memberId}, #{productId}, #{productType}, #{productTitle}, #{productCover}, #{unitPrice}, #{quantity}, #{amount}, #{payAmount}, #{status}, #{travelDate}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{remark}, 0, now(), now())
mapper.update: update hys_order set status = #{to}, update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and status = #{from}
update hys_order set status = 1, pay_type = #{payType}, pay_amount = #{payAmount}, pay_time = now(), update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 0
update hys_order set status = 3, after_sale = 1, refund_reason = #{reason}, update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and status in (1, 2)
update hys_order set status = 4, after_sale = 2, refund_time = now(), update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and status in (1, 2, 3)
update hys_order set status = 1, after_sale = 3, update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 3
mapper.select: select count(1) from hys_order where create_time >= #{start}
select count(1) from hys_order where status = #{status}
select count(1) from hys_order where product_id = #{productId}
select coalesce(sum(pay_amount), 0) from hys_order where status in (1, 2)

select date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') as d, count(1) as orders, coalesce(sum(case when status in (1, 2) then pay_amount else 0 end), 0) as amount from hys_order where create_time >= #{start} group by date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') order by d asc
